scope: Feasibility and implementation constraints only; no panel writes or runtime switching performed
user_preference: Switch between original UI and custom program without device reboot
current_state: Persistent white counter installed; original vapp main and application package retained
proposed_mechanism: One launcher serializes two UI lifetimes. Native counter stops drawing/counting before entering original main. To return, a control task requests original app cooperative exit through the verified async stop path, waits for original main to complete GUI cleanup, then starts/resumes the counter UI.
state_machine: CUSTOM_QUIESCING: stop custom display submissions and UI touch actions
ORIGINAL_STARTING: enter unchanged vapp main with original application arguments
ORIGINAL_ACTIVE: original app owns foreground display/input
ORIGINAL_STOP_REQUESTED: notify initialized original runtime asynchronously
ORIGINAL_QUIESCING: await run return, app thread completion and GUI teardown
CUSTOM_ACTIVE: establish own source and touch state again
what_is_confirmed: Original main body remains present, and a stop/destroy lifecycle exists
Original normal mode includes a separate App/JS thread; the parent command task alone is not the whole UI
Touch driver fans out to independent subscribers; framebuffer has one global queue without per-file producer ownership
Underlying OS, hardware drivers, panel services and device configuration can remain running
required_before_install: Prove stop request readiness and thread-safety, including framework/context lifetime during watcher calls
Prove full stop, worker and input/render callback closure and repeated original-main initialization
Wait until no old source remains in display queue before freeing owned buffers
Select a switch gesture/control that cannot also trigger an unintended original UI action
Fit compiled launcher/controller within independently audited code containers
Validate a RAM or narrowly scoped persistent round trip original-to-custom-to-original with exact rollback
first_version_limit: Cooperative destruction/recreation may reopen original UI at its homepage. No interface preserving the original page and full JS state has been demonstrated.
implementation_status: Not yet implemented or verified on the device; current installed counter has no bidirectional switch control
